finding.problem: Saved soundtrack clips bypassed native event-marker validation and could use replaced template timing. The reset/more-room fixture accepted passage frame 470 (sample 940000) without a mapped native marker, in export and Lab attachment.

changes: The shared native validator includes saved soundtrack clip event anchors alongside legacy passage sounds.
Native pictures may retain mappings for known beat events before a saved soundtrack is attached; unknown event IDs still fail.
Passage export reads the saved project and validates native bindings before picture preparation.
Lab validates before requesting audio rendering, before attachment and before playback against the current native compositions.
The native passage export regression uses an audible saved clip on mapped reset/shared-strain and checks preserved decoded picture frames on both backends.
regressions: Missing and mismatched saved-event markers fail with comp-passage-binding before Lab audio decode.
Matching markers attach/play correctly; changed native marker timing rejects playback without scheduling a source.
CLI render rejects unmapped saved events before reading prepared scenes.
Actual Lab controls report beat/event diagnostics and issue no audio-render request for an unmapped saved event.
beforeFixFailures: With complete synthetic timing, Lab setSoundtrack resolved true for an unmapped event instead of rejecting.
A known event mapping authored before soundtrack attachment was incorrectly rejected as unknown.
CLI render reached missing prepared-scene files instead of rejecting the saved native event binding.
harnessCorrections: Initial synthetic beat omitted its start frame; corrected before relying on regression evidence.
The first Lab attempt timed out because optional soundtrack details were collapsed; opening them exercises the actual control.
Initial module probes used wrong lint paths; corrected path plus the repository tsx loader passes. Plain Node strip-only imports encounter an existing cinematic parameter property.
isolation: Managed worktree with its own frozen-lockfile node_modules and Vite optimizer/config caches. Separate Python preflight environment and hash-pinned soundtrack runtime (DawDreamer 0.9.0, NumPy 2.3.3, SciPy 1.16.2); imports pass. Owner checkout untouched.

checks.note: Isolated Python 3.12.11 environment with UV_NO_SYNC=1; pinned Node/pnpm/FFmpeg and Chromium startup verified.
